_schema: Sub-Spec D4 interaction matrix encoded as a deterministic lookup. Resolve in environment phase after propagation, before DoT (D5). 'a' meets 'b' -> result. Precedence: Water beats Fire; Fire+Gas beats everything (explode); Water disperses Gas; Steam dries Water.

interactions.note: Water wins: Fire removed from tile
Shock chains through all connected soaked tiles
Water wins on the tile; fire does not establish
IGNITE -> Explosion over the gas volume
Steam dries Water on its tile
Explosion clears the Gas it ignited

explosion.effect: one-time over volume: damage + radial impulse to all entities (via Sub-Spec A resolver); clears Gas; may seed residual Fire
